A '''devourer tank''' was an air purification device that used a [[Devourer organism|red microorganism]] that consumed organic matter and acted as a cover for a wheel that activated an access-way into secret chambers on [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]]. [[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker]] encountered one in [[27 ABY/Legends|27 ABY]].
